cards.question: Which health-insurance cost is paid monthly for coverage, even when you receive no medical care?
cards.answerExplanation: The premium pays for coverage itself. Deductibles, copayments and coinsurance concern what you pay for covered care, rather than the monthly cost of keeping insurance.
cards.whyNow: The White House announced refunds for certain people buying insurance through the federal exchange, putting premiums and other insurance costs in focus.

coreFactSources.title: Your total costs for health care: Premium, deductible & out-of-pocket costs

newsPegSources.headline: Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Announces the Working Families Obamacare Refunds

cards.question: Whose portrait did Dolley Madison famously arrange to preserve from the White House in 1814?
cards.answerExplanation: She directed the rescue of Gilbert Stuart's portrait of George Washington. Staff helped remove it, and two visitors carried it away for safekeeping—the preservation was a shared effort.
cards.whyNow: Melania Trump discussed preserving White House interiors and decorative arts at a presidential-sites summit, recalling the enduring importance of protecting its historic objects.

newsPegSources.headline: First Lady Melania Trump’s Personal Vision to Preserve America’s Story Through Superior Design

cards.question: On a ski slope, what are moguls?
cards.answerExplanation: Moguls are snow bumps. In competition, skiers navigate a course of these bumps and perform aerial jumps, with turns, speed and aerial skill contributing to their score.
cards.whyNow: Edgar Grospiron, an Olympic moguls champion, has left the leadership of the 2030 Winter Olympics organising committee, bringing his skiing discipline back into view.

coreFactSources.title: Moguls 101: Understanding Moguls and Dual Moguls

newsPegSources.headline: 2030 Winter Olympics boss departs amid turmoil

cards.question: Why can a dark nebula look like a hole in a star-filled sky?
choices: Dust blocks light from stars behind it
A black hole traps the surrounding light
An empty gap contains no stars
The stars there have all burned out
cards.canonicalAnswer: Dust blocks light from stars behind it
cards.answerExplanation: A dark nebula contains dust thick enough to block visible light from objects behind it. Its dark silhouette marks obscuring material, rather than simply an empty patch of space.
cards.whyNow: NASA's September 10 Astronomy Picture of the Day features the Giraffe Nebula, a dark cloud whose silhouette invites viewers to spot an animal shape.

newsPegSources.headline: APOD: 2026 September 10 – LDN 1295: The Giraffe Nebula

cards.question: In a rental report, what does the median rent describe?
choices: The middle value after rents are ordered
The total rent divided by the number of homes
The rent charged by the greatest number of homes
The halfway point between the lowest and highest rents
cards.canonicalAnswer: The middle value after rents are ordered
cards.answerExplanation: The median is the middle of the ordered values; with an even number, it averages the two middle values. Unlike the mean, it is less affected by unusually high or low prices.
cards.whyNow: San Francisco's mayor declared a rent emergency, and the report uses median rents to describe housing costs. Knowing what that measure means helps decode the comparison.

newsPegSources.headline: San Francisco mayor declares rent emergency as housing costs soar
